claim_summary: TSAG contributes an evaluation framework and benchmark for measuring LLM agents' financial time-series query parsing, tool selection, parameter extraction, and grounded responses, implemented on a fixed tool-augmented workflow.

claim_evidence.quote: • A novel evaluation methodology and benchmark for isolating and measuring an LLM agent’s core reasoning skills (parsing, tool selection, parameter extraction) for financial Q&A, independent of live data noise.

modules.name: Specialized financial temporal tools
modules.scope_reason: TSK: the tools embed task-specific analytical outputs such as prediction, anomaly/pattern detection, volatility, and correlation; changing the task family changes the tool semantics. Counterfactual: a different task requires different tools/objectives, so the procedure must be redesigned.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - specialized functions embed task-specific analytical outputs and objectives

evidence.quote: • Price and Volatility Analysis: Tools (price, volatility) retrieving current data or calculating historical metrics (e.g., Parkinson volatility (Parkinson 1980)) along with respective prediction tools (predict_price, predict_volatility).

modules.name: LLM-orchestrated tool workflow
modules.scope_reason: GH: the procedure controls the execution sequence without temporal semantics or an embedded task-family objective. Counterfactual: changing the task changes selected tools, but the general parse-execute-synthesize-response control flow remains the same.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - workflow sequence is not a task objective
R3_2_GTS:no - sequence control has no temporal-semantic state

modules.name: Financial time-series tool-use benchmark and evaluation
modules.scope_reason: GH: evaluation verifies execution/tool orchestration across benchmark queries and does not itself perform temporal data operations or embody one task procedure. Counterfactual: its checks would still assess tool routing and response behavior if query categories changed.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - benchmark evaluates reasoning across query types rather than implementing one task procedure
R3_2_GTS:no - evaluator has no temporal data state or availability logic

evidence.quote: • Match Accuracy (MA): This metric programmatically validates the agent’s reasoning by checking if the generated tool name and all extracted parameters are an exact match with a ground-truth object.

process_validity.quote: • Return Rate (RR): For each of the benchmark items end-to-end execution success indicator, set to 1.0 if any non-empty text result is returned by the TSAG framework in response to the benchmark NLQ, and 0.0 otherwise.

task_performance.quote: • LLM-accessed Accuracy (LA): For each of the benchmark items - measure of accuracy comparing the expected NLR from benchmark against the actual NLR, assessed by DeepEval (Confident AI 2023) in the range between 0.0 and 1.0.
